== Released date and exact published wording ==
The printed slip places the period inside the closing quotation mark in <code>"escort."</code>, while the 21 July 2012 card-list capture places it outside in <code>'escort'.</code> The earlier Released bound has been removed because that capture establishes different published punctuation. The printed wording is retained. Sources: Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=6 VirtualBlock3 printed release sheet], page 6; [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VMasterType.html Virtual Cards: Master List], captured 21 July 2012. The sheet’s text-as-of date is not being substituted for a publication date.
